I build machine learning systems and the backends that carry them. Currently
finishing an MTech in Artificial Intelligence at MANIT Bhopal, where my thesis
work is on deep learning architectures for multivariate time-series imputation,
and working as an apprentice at Philips on retrieval-augmented compliance
pipelines.

## Selected work

**DriftWatch** — an autonomous GitHub App that detects documentation drift in
merged pull requests. FastAPI, tree-sitter AST diffing, Gemini embeddings over
PostgreSQL with pgvector, deployed on Render.
[Repository](https://github.com/ashwinruke/driftwatch)

**GMRTI** — a masked recurrent-transformer architecture for imputing missing
values in multivariate time series. MTech thesis work.

**MedRAG** — retrieval-augmented regulatory compliance analysis for MedTech,
built at Philips.
